Callout.Name: Self-Harm Concern
Callout.Message: Inmate assessed as a risk, staff requesting attendance.
Callout.Advisory: No injury yet, staff on the door.

Script.Line: He has been assessed and he is on fifteen minute checks.
He has not said a word since yesterday, and that is not like him.
I am asking properly. I am asking you to come and see him.

Lines.Approach: He has told staff what he intends to do and they believe him. Nobody is hurt yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
